I have completed the implementation of typed window functions, frame utilities, and `.window()` query builder support in a new branch `feat/window-functions`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Expression Helpers & Utilities ([`window.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts)):**
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L166), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L171), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L176), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L181), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L194), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L199).
   - **Offset helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L235), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L265), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L205), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L212), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L219).
   - **Aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L296), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L301), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L306), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L313), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L320) (emits `count(*)` when called without arguments).
   - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L78), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L83), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L26), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L27), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L28), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L30), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L37).
   - **Builder**: [`WindowBuilder`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L133) with `.over(spec?)` supporting inline specifications (`partitionBy`, `orderBy`, `frame`) or named string windows.
   - **Validation & Constraints**:
     - Numeric positional arguments emit literal values (`sql.raw`) rather than bound query parameters.
     - `ntile` and `nthValue` reject non-positive integer arguments referencing function name and value.
     - `rows` and `range` reject invalid boundaries where `from` is ordered after `to` referencing `"from"`.
     - `preceding` and `following` reject negative and non-integer arguments referencing helper names.
     - Nullable typing on value access functions; `lag` and `lead` strip `null` when a default value is supplied.
   - Re-exported all utilities through [`drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/index.ts) to the top-level package.

2. **Dialect & Query Builder Support:**
   - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` method and configuration across all supported dialects (`pg-core`, `mysql-core`, `sqlite-core`, `singlestore-core`, `gel-core`).
   - Added validation in `.window(name, spec)` rejecting empty names (containing `"non-empty"`) and whitespace-only names (containing `"whitespace"`).
   - Updated each dialect's `buildSelectQuery` to compile named windows into `WINDOW <name> AS (<spec>)` positioned right before `ORDER BY`.

3. **Verification & Tests:**
   - Added comprehensive test suite in [`drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) covering all 8 acceptance criteria and constraints across all 5 dialects.
   - Ran `pnpm test` (611 tests passing across 14 test files, including export verification).
   - Ran `pnpm test:types` (0 errors).
   - Ran `pnpm lint` (0 formatting/lint issues).
   - Ran `pnpm build:orm` (clean build).
   - All changes committed to branch `feat/window-functions`.
